category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response holds the line with wit and substance, acknowledging playoff results without conceding superiority and bringing up depth, NFL draft, and the 'January is a small sample' idea.
quote: One playoff appearance doesn't erase a decade of SEC championship parades. We’re talking about a conference that has won seven of the last nine national titles and produced more first-round NFL draft picks than your entire conference combined.
